title: Oak Ridge, IBM and AMD Launch Co-Design Platform for Quantum Error Correction
detail: Oak Ridge National Laboratory, IBM and AMD announced a joint platform pairing IBM's 120-qubit Nighthawk processor with ORNL's AMD-based Umbra supercomputer to test real-time quantum error-correction decoding, supporting a DOE goal of 100 logical qubits and 100,000 operations by late 2028.
